selected_memories.text: Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with GOL-67 is VOR-90.
When KEL-89 encounters GOL-67, the validated terminal code becomes XAN-85.
When active BEX-14 is present, it produces KEL-89.
Official rule: activating TEK-11 converts BEX-14 into its active form.
Official revision: for the chain involving KEL-89 and GOL-67, the accepted terminal code is XAN-85; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When NIX-56 encounters TEK-81, the validated terminal code becomes WIR-76.
When active CYN-37 is present, it produces NIX-56.
Official rule: activating VOR-42 converts CYN-37 into its active form.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with TEK-81 is LUM-68.
Official revision: for the chain involving NIX-56 and TEK-81, the accepted terminal code is WIR-76; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Official rule: activating MUR-68 converts HAP-33 into its active form.
When active HAP-33 is present, it produces BEX-42.
When BEX-42 encounters BEX-65, the validated terminal code becomes DEX-46.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with BEX-65 is DEX-89.
Official revision: for the chain involving BEX-42 and BEX-65, the accepted terminal code is DEX-46; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
